query_wording: For Pxxxxxx, compare the PAD and signed financing agreement. Where do the project description, effectiveness conditions, disbursement conditions, or implementing arrangements differ?

placeholders.reason: Its PAD (2021-04-30) and signed Financing Agreement for Credit 6867-TZ (signed 19 August 2021) are both public; they largely match, which tests that the agent does not invent differences.

turns.user: For P164920, compare the PAD and signed financing agreement. Where do the project description, effectiveness conditions, disbursement conditions, or implementing arrangements differ?

text: Documents: PAD2934 (2021-04-30) and the Financing Agreement for Credit 6867-TZ between the United Republic of Tanzania and IDA (signed 19 August 2021; record dated 2021-08-19). The agreement's text is a scan; citations use its printed page numbers. Overall the two match closely: the PAD's datasheet already quotes the agreement's conditions and covenants.

Project description: the objective is identical (PAD p. 23; FA Schedule 1, p. 6). The FA describes the same five components and sub-components (FA Schedule 1, pp. 6-8; PAD pp. 24-29) but without amounts, and it adds scope detail such as routine maintenance of approximately 23,000 km of district roads and bottleneck improvements in all Mainland regions except Dar es Salaam (FA p. 6). Financing is expressed differently: the PAD gives US$ by component (IDA US$300 million, Government US$50 million; PAD pp. 8-9), the FA allocates SDR 208,500,000 by disbursement category - Category 1 TANROADS sub-component 1(a) SDR 76,440,000; Category 2 TARURA sub-components 1(b)-(d) SDR 114,310,000; Category 4 TARURA components 2-4 SDR 16,135,000; Category 5 CERC SDR 0; Category 3 (TANROADS 2(c), 2(d) and 4) is illegible in the scan (the balance would be SDR 1,615,000) (FA Schedule 2, Section III.A, pp. 11-12). The FA makes land acquisition and resettlement compensation ineligible, to be financed by the Recipient (p. 12), consistent with the PAD's note that the Government covers resettlement costs (PAD p. 24, footnote 27).

Effectiveness conditions: no difference. Both list (a) subsidiary agreements between the Recipient and the implementing entities, (b) the Steering Committee established, (c) TARURA's PIU established and staffed, (d) the Project Implementation Manual adopted (FA Article IV, Section 4.01, p. 3; PAD p. 13). The FA adds the 90-day effectiveness deadline (Section 4.02, p. 3).

Disbursement conditions: no difference. Both bar withdrawals under Category 1 until TANROADS, and under Category 2 until TARURA, adopt Operational Health and Safety Measures pursuant to the ESCP, and under Category 5 (CERC) until an eligible emergency is determined and accepted and the CERC Manual and Emergency Action Plan are adopted (FA Schedule 2, Section III.B.1(b)-(d), pp. 12-13; PAD p. 13). Closing date 30 June 2027 in both (FA p. 13; PAD p. 8).

Implementing arrangements: consistent, with differences of detail. Both have a Steering Committee co-chaired by the Permanent Secretaries of PO-RALG and MoWT meeting at least twice a year (FA Schedule 2, Section I.A, p. 9; PAD p. 41, para. 75); the FA names its members (TARURA, TANROADS, PO-RALG, MoWT, MoFP) and adds the Roads Fund Board and LATRA as special invitees. The FA adds subsidiary-agreement rules (Section I.B), CERC Manual requirements (Section I.C, pp. 9-10) and semi-annual project reports within 45 days (Section II, p. 11). The PIU, technical committee, procurement capacity plans, external auditor and PIM covenants the PAD lists (PAD p. 12) are in the Project Agreement with TARURA and TANROADS, not in the Financing Agreement.
Later changes are not part of this comparison: the agreement was amended in 2025 (First Amendment, 2025-09-30) alongside the additional financing.

right_sources: Uses the PAD (33121051) and the signed Financing Agreement for Credit 6867-TZ (33356405), not the 2025 AF agreements.
grounded: Each point cites a PAD page and an FA clause; no difference is claimed that the documents do not show; unreadable parts of the scan are flagged, not guessed.
complete: Addresses all four areas, stating 'no difference' where the texts match.
scoped: Notes where obligations sit in the Project Agreement rather than the Financing Agreement, and that later amendments are outside the comparison.

notes: The SDR 114,310,000 for Category 2 is read from OCR text '1143 10,000'; the reviewer should confirm against the PDF.
